remarks: Behind the gates of Calabasas Park Estates, this reimagined Mediterranean residence pairs timeless architecture with contemporary restraint, all set against sweeping views of the golf course. Five bedrooms and six baths unfold across a home renovated from top to bottom, with wide-plank French oak floors, elevated finishes, and a natural sense of flow. The chef's kitchen anchors the home: custom shaker cabinetry, professional-grade appliances, quartz surfaces, a herringbone backsplash, and an oversized waterfall island with bar seating.
